title: Descartes Sets Date to Announce Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results

WATERLOO, Ontario and ATLANTA, Georgia, November 2, 2026 -- Descartes Systems Group (TSX: DSG) (Nasdaq: DSGX), the global leader in uniting logistics-intensive businesses in commerce, is scheduled to report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results after market close on Wednesday, December 2, 2026.


Members of Descartes' executive management team will host a conference call to discuss the company's financial results at5:30 p.m. ET on Wednesday, December 2, 2026. Designated numbers are +1 289 514 5100 or Toll-Free for North America at +1 800 717 1738, using conference ID 32904.


The company will simultaneously conduct an audio webcast on the Descartes website at[www.descartes.com/descartes/investor-relations.](https://www.descartes.com/who-we-are/investor-relations/financial-information) A phone conference dial-in or webcast log-in is required approximately 10 minutes before the start.


Replays of the conference call will be available until Wednesday, December 9, 2026, by dialing +1 289 819 1325 or Toll-Free for North America using +1 888 660 6264 with Playback Passcode: 32904#. An archived replay of the webcast will be available at[www.descartes.com/descartes/investor-relations](https://www.descartes.com/who-we-are/investor-relations/financial-information) .


**About Descartes**


Descartes powers more responsive, efficient, secure, and sustainable international and domestic supply chains by uniting logistics-intensive businesses on its Global Logistics Network (GLN). Shippers, carriers, and logistics service providers connect and collaborate on the GLN, leveraging technology, data, and AI to manage last-mile deliveries, domestic and international shipments, transportation rating and payment, global trade research, customs compliance, and a variety of regulatory processes. Learn more about Descartes at[www.descartes.com](http://www.descartes.com/) and connect with us on LinkedIn and X.
